hero.perdisteTitulo: You need more curiosity to save the cat

sobreMi.p1: I'm Andrea Robles. I've spent 8 years specialising in technology and data applied to social development projects. I hold a teaching degree from the University of León, went on to postgraduate studies in Marketing and e-commerce at INESDI (Barcelona), and later completed a Master's in Artificial Intelligence and Big Data at Digitech (Barcelona) — but most of what I know I've learned from real projects that push me to learn something new every day.
sobreMi.p2: I'm interested in the intersection between people and technology, between the analogue and the digital, and in how we can use the tools within our reach to build a better society.
sobreMi.p3: I build projects with real social impact: I put tools, data, automation and process digitisation to work in environments that seek collective improvement.

actual.descripcion: I lead the technology strategy of a social impact organisation, driving digitisation, data integration and AI initiatives to make processes more efficient and scalable.

puesto1.descripcion: Defined the technology roadmap, integrated tools and coordinated technical teams and vendors. From diagnosis to rollout.

puesto2.descripcion: Full digital strategy — content direction and creation, SEO, SEM, social ads, analytics.

puesto3.descripcion: Digital projects for clients across a range of sectors. Multichannel communication with marketing automation, coordinating with development and design.
